stem.text: The boiling points of some hydrogen halides are shown.
What is the explanation for the trend in boiling point for the hydrogen halides from $\text{HCl}$ to $\text{HI}$?

A.text: The bond energies of the hydrogen halides increase from $\text{HCl}$ to $\text{HI}$.

B.text: There is an increase in the strength of the intermolecular forces of attraction from $\text{HCl}$ to $\text{HI}$.

C.text: The intermolecular hydrogen bonds become stronger from $\text{HCl}$ to $\text{HI}$.

D.text: There is an increase in the bond polarity from $\text{HCl}$ to $\text{HI}$.
